dogecoin.text: The kappa theme (mischievous frog spirit) adds a fun, unique identity—unlike generic tokens. Culture can drive adoption, as seen with Dogecoin.

#COMMUNITY isn’t about charts or devs tweeting pumps. It’s about people. 5,000+ holders, +89.8% in 24h, +112% in 3 days. This isn’t a token with a roadmap—it’s a narrative. Like Dogecoin in 2013, it’s starting as a joke but could end as a billion-dollar community experiment. CA:
